raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyfes
  version: "2026.5.2"
  sha256: f7b1e170d9726423583adb425fe9fdb1c5e2494104fe8eea193c339d561b2fed
  build_number: 1

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/CNES/aviso-fes/releases/download/${{ version }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.11")
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation ${{ '-Cgenerator="Visual Studio 17 2022"' if win else '' }} ${{ '-Ccmake-args=-DCMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING=ON' if osx and arm64 else '' }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - setuptools
    - if: linux or osx
      then: ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: win
      then: vs2017_win-64
    - cmake
    - if: linux or osx
      then: make
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - numpy
    - cmake
    - eigen
    - if: linux or win
      then: mkl
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
    - libboost-devel >=1.90
  run:
    - ${{ pin_compatible('numpy') }}
    - python
    - netcdf4
    - pyyaml
    - if: linux or win
      then: mkl

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyfes

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/CNES/aviso-fes
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: FES prediction software
  description: |
    This package is the fully revised version of the FES distribution.
    This distribution includes the FES tidal prediction software.
  documentation: https://cnes.github.io/aviso-fes
  repository: https://github.com/CNES/aviso-fes

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - fbriol
